narratives.body: RB Leipzig coach Martín Demichelis has publicly praised Real Madrid's new signing, Yan Diomande, ahead of their Champions League clash at the Bernabéu. Multiple sources report that Demichelis 'raved' about the player, highlighting his potential impact despite the daunting nature of the upcoming match against his former club's rivals.
narratives.headline: Demichelis praises Yan Diomande ahead of Leipzig vs Real Madrid clash

narratives.body: In a separate development, Demichelis addressed the situation of Franco Mastantuono, who is on loan at Fiorentina. He stated that Mastantuono 'needs time' to develop and insisted that the player is fundamentally built for Real Madrid, despite his current spell away from the Spanish giants.
narratives.headline: Demichelis insists Franco Mastantuono is built for Real Madrid
